characters.summary: Jessica Jones relies on superhuman strength and durability to close the distance in close-quarters combat, often compensating for a lack of formal martial arts training with sheer force and resilience.
limitations: Lacks formal combat training, relying primarily on raw power.

sources.supports: Superhuman strength, durability, and general background in the MCU.

feats.claim: Lifted a heavy car and tossed open reinforced security doors with ease.

notableResults.note: Their fight ended without a decisive victor due to mutual superhuman durability.

unknowns: Exact upper limit of her lifting capacity and durability threshold.

characters.summary: Jimmy Woo is an FBI agent who relies on standard law enforcement firearms, tactical gear, and basic hand-to-hand combat training, supplemented by parlor tricks like close-up magic.
limitations: Peak human physical conditioning with no superhuman attributes.

sources.supports: FBI background, training, and appearances in the MCU.

feats.claim: Successfully mastered close-up magic card tricks.

campaignTags.claim: Uses business cards and sleight-of-hand tricks learned from Scott Lang.

unknowns: Extent of field combat capabilities outside of standard agency protocol.

characters.summary: John Walker is a highly decorated military veteran enhanced by the Super Soldier Serum, fighting with aggressive tactical brawling, firearms, and the Vibranium-alloy shield.
weaknesses: Psychological instability and intense pressure to live up to the Captain America mantle
mobility: Peak human athletic speed and endurance enhanced by the Super Soldier Serum
limitations: Vulnerable to psychological manipulation and emotional outbursts.

sources.supports: Background, Super Soldier enhancement, and MCU depiction in The Falcon and the Winter Soldier.

feats.claim: Engaged and held his own against Flag Smasher super soldiers in hand-to-hand combat.
feats.citation: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

notableResults.citation: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
notableResults.note: Fought alongside Falcon against Bucky and Sam, ending in a tactical loss.

conditional.dependsOn: Possession of the Captain America shield

unknowns: Long-term stability and psychological effects of the specific Super Soldier variant he ingested.

characters.summary: Kaecilius is a rogue Master of the Mystic Arts who wields dimensional energy, spatial manipulation, and magical blade constructs to overwhelm opponents.
weaknesses: Reliance on dimensional power sources for sustained magic
limitations: Dependent on the mystical arts and connection to dark dimensions for advanced feats.

sources.supports: Abilities, mystical training, and role in Doctor Strange.

feats.claim: Manipulated the geometry of New York City within the Mirror Dimension.

notableResults.note: Defeated when Strange trapped him and Dormammu in a time loop.

campaignTags.claim: Master of the Mystic Arts capable of casting complex dimensional spells.
Able to fold space and open portals.

unknowns: Extent of power without the backing of the Dark Dimension.

characters.summary: Kate Bishop is a highly skilled archer and martial artist who utilizes trick arrows, tactical agility, and sharp marksmanship to engage opponents from a distance.
limitations: Limited physical durability and dependent on ammunition supply.

sources.supports: Archery skills, training, and MCU appearance in Hawkeye.

feats.claim: Successfully engaged multiple Tracksuit Mafia members using advanced archery and trick arrows.

campaignTags.claim: Carries specialized trick arrows with various explosive and utility payloads.

unknowns: Proficiency with heavy firearms compared to traditional archery.

characters.summary: Katy is an expert driver and casual archer who relies on vehicle maneuvers and spontaneous support actions during combat encounters.
weaknesses: Standard human vulnerability with minimal formal combat training
limitations: Lacks hand-to-hand combat training and superhuman physical traits.

sources.supports: Katy's role, driving feats, and archery training in Shang-Chi.

feats.claim: Landed a critical arrow shot during the battle of Ta Lo.
feats.citation: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

campaignTags.claim: Demonstrates expert tactical driving skills under extreme conditions.

unknowns: Long-term effectiveness in sustained combat without vehicle support.

characters.summary: Killmonger is a ruthless Black Ops mercenary and martial artist who utilizes peak human conditioning, Wakandan vibranium weapons, and the synthetic Heart-Shaped Herb enhancement.

mechanisms: Enhanced durability from the Heart-Shaped Herb

weaknesses: Arrogance and intense desire for global conflict
limitations: Vulnerable to specialized sonic dampeners designed to disrupt vibranium weave.

sources.supports: Combat skills, Wakandan tech usage, and Black Panther appearance.

feats.claim: Defeated T'Challa in ritual combat for the Wakandan throne.

notableResults.note: Won the first ritual combat by throwing T'Challa over a waterfall.

conditional.ability: Kinetic energy blast discharge and impervious armor

campaignTags.claim: Wears the vibranium-weave Black Panther habit providing kinetic energy absorption.

unknowns: Exact duration of enhanced physical attributes without regular access to the herb.

characters.summary: Kingo is an immortal Eternal who channels cosmic energy through his hands to project rapid-fire projectile blasts in combat.
weaknesses: Reluctance to engage in lethal conflicts with former allies
limitations: Cannot alter his fundamental cosmic energy projection style.

sources.supports: Kingo's Eternal physiology and cosmic projectile abilities.

feats.claim: Fired rapid streams of cosmic energy projectiles during battles against Deviants.

campaignTags.claim: Capable of sustained space and atmospheric flight as an Eternal.
Innate Eternal ability to levitate and fly.

unknowns: Full potential of his cosmic blasts when not holding back for cinematic or dramatic reasons.

characters.summary: Wilson Fisk (Kingpin) is a crime lord possessing immense physical mass, brutal strength, and high-level tactical influence, overpowering opponents with sheer size and merciless brawling.
weaknesses: Prone to blind rage when personal relationships or control are threatened
limitations: Lacks agility and speed against faster, acrobatic martial artists.

sources.supports: Strength, durability, and appearances in Daredevil and Hawkeye.

feats.claim: Decapitated a car door and severely beat opponents with bare hands.

notableResults.note: Defeated after an exhaustive street brawl due to cumulative damage.

unknowns: Exact physical composition of his durability against superhuman attacks.
